## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, prerequisite read for the Landau fan

Raw traces precede the FFTs below. Both completed with stable drain current (9.81–9.94 nA), sample T 1.165–1.292 K, |gate current| <0.22 nA, and |Rxx| <0.59 kOhm versus 5 kOhm full scale. Region is the sole wired pair B_1–B_2; the two CNP ridges from run 5 remain a spatial-density confound.

Electron run 6 (n=+3.2e12, D≈0) contains candidates near 7.3, 14.8, 22.3 and 29.4 T; frequency proximity to harmonics alone cannot screen them. Hole run 7 (n=−1.2e12) has near 4.7, 6.6 and 12.3 T content, with close tones and limited allowed hole density. **Call: stacking uninformative at this stage.** A density trajectory and global scale fit are required, including ABAB and adjacent-N overlays, and the F_L-tone origin checks in `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Verify.

Default electron `sdh_onset` reports 0.30 T, censored; restricting to the adequately sampled B≥1 T segment still reports a censored 1 T edge. Below 1 T, the 50 mT grid was background-only and does not Nyquist the full frequency set. Thus neither result pins a physical onset. Next is a short low-field electron extension, then one cost-floored electron fan; no low-field absence claim is supported yet. The hole-side helper onset is 0.714 T, but its accessible density window cannot reach the clean high-density 4L template separation.
EOF

## HERA — resolve the electron onset before committing the fan

`sdh-spot-check` / `landau-fan` cost-floor prerequisite: run 6's onset is censored at 0.30 T, and its 50 mT grid below 1 T was explicitly background-only. This extension measures the same +3.2e12 cm^-2, D≈0 point with Δ(1/B)=0.01197 T^-1 (Nyquist 41.77 T, covering F_L=33.09 T plus 20% scale allowance), using the validated run-5 calibration and unchanged 3 s magnet settling (10τ at 24 dB/oct). It bridges 0.2–1.5 T to overlap run 6 and replaces the under-sampled onset segment; it is not evidence for a stacking call alone.

SAFETIES cell 18 [10] and VERIFY cell 32 [17] match all card limits; same-kernel handoff cells 44–46 confirm base T, zero gates/field, grant/binding retained. Preconditions re-read validators, base thermometry/freshness, heaters off, PS/output, drive and acquisition settings before writes; Si stays at zero. Ramp budget from 0 to 1.5 T is 1.5×7.3=10.95 min; measured run-6/7 overhead ≈3.08 s/field point gives 18.6 min, plus gate positioning, liveness and margin → 33 min. No ramp-rate or safety changes.

Checkpoint: inspect the first 10 points for current, leakage, clipping and temperature, then at 15 min and completion. Stop on |gate current|>1 nA, off-base temperature or clipping. A kernel interrupt stops acquisition, but this VTI supply finishes its current target; re-read field after any abort. Leave field at 1.5 T and gates at this point for the ensuing fan direction decision. The full fan will be committed after this onset read, with both Nyquist axes and model partner-period budget computed.
EOF
